messages:
Priya Sharma: :rotating_light: BillingOps seeing a cluster of overage alerts and inflated token counts around 12:18-12:25 UTC. Alerts: `billing.overage.alerts` and `metering.delta.anomaly`. Not sure if real traffic spike or a counting bug. Root alert created at 12:22 UTC.

incident-bot: Pager posted to #incidents (severity: P2). Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/metering-drift. Trigger details: delta-agg consumer lag spike + duplicate increments detected.

Marco Diaz: I'll take triage. Quick checks: consumer group `delta-aggregator` lag, pod restarts, and commit offsets. @incident-bot paste last 30m consumer lag.

incident-bot: last_30m consumer_lag(delta-aggregator): avg=0.3, max=14.1 (spike at ~12:19 UTC).

Alice Nguyen: I see elevated GC pause durations in `stream-processor` at ~12:18-12:21. Could be triggering retries and duplicate processing. Pulling pod logs.

Priya Sharma: Sample from Billing snapshots: `acct: acme-corp, window: 2026-03-15T12:00Z-12:30Z, tokens_reported: 192, tokens_expected: 96` -- looks like ~2x counting for some windows.

Marco Diaz: Running live commands for context:
```
kubectl -n metering get pods -l app=delta-aggregator
kubectl logs -n metering delta-aggregator-7aa --since=45m | grep -i commit-offset
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --describe --group delta-aggregator
```

Marco Diaz: Log snippet shows retry processing of same batch:
```
2026-03-15T12:19:58Z delta-agg INFO processed batch 8729 size=48 commit-offset=134512
2026-03-15T12:19:58Z delta-agg WARN transient error - scheduling retry
2026-03-15T12:19:59Z delta-agg INFO processed batch 8729 size=48 commit-offset=134512 (retry)
```
Looks like the retry path reprocessed before commit was recorded.

Alice Nguyen: Confirmed: recent rollout `delta-agg v2.4.1` upgraded `kafka-client` to 3.6; commit semantics changed slightly. Our idempotency guard didn't handle the new timing. Filing a bug.

Priya Sharma: Immediate customer impact assessment: (1) ~130 accounts received transient overage alerts, (2) ~35 accounts show inflated dashboard usage for the last hour, (3) no finalized invoices posted yet. Finance flagged no charges yet.

BillingOps: We're pausing automated overage emails and preparing a manual review list. Please halt any webhooks to accounting.

Marco Diaz: Proposed mitigations:
1) Roll back delta-agg to v2.4.0 (last known-good)
2) Temporarily scale down `billing-forwarder` to 0 to stop inflating billing triggers
3) Kick off backfill/reconcile job to compute canonical counts for suspect windows
4) Notify CS for top ARR customers

Alice Nguyen: Initiating rollback now. Will watch offsets to ensure we don't reprocess already-committed ranges.

Marco Diaz: Rollback command executed:
```
kubectl set image deployment/delta-aggregator delta-agg=redwood/delta-agg:2.4.0 -n metering
```

incident-bot: Rollout status: 0% -> 100% complete. Rollback finished at 12:44 UTC, no new restarts in last 10m.

Alice Nguyen: Paused forwarder: `kubectl scale deployment billing-forwarder --replicas=0 -n billing` at 12:46 UTC :white_check_mark:.

Priya Sharma: BillingOps opened ticket FIN-9876 for crediting and reconciliation. Extracting impacted account list now.

BillingOps: Query we ran to get affected accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(token_delta) AS tokens
FROM metering.delta_views
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-15T11:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-15T12:45:00Z'
  AND environment='prod'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 250;
```

Anita Patel: Product & CS: please draft a short customer notification in #customer-success. Keep it factual: transient alerts, investigating, no charges applied yet. Prioritize outreach for top 10 ARR accounts.

Marco Diaz: Recon job started at 12:50 UTC. Job id recon-1900223344. Output S3 prefix: `s3://recon-results/recon-1900223344/`. Recon ETA ~35-45m for 2hr window. Reconciler will write `reconcile_manifest.json` when done.

Alice Nguyen: Added a temp metric `metering.dedupe.fails` showing ~2800 fails around 12:18-12:21 which aligns with observed duplicates. Adding integration test for retry path now.

Priya Sharma: Finance confirms no invoices posted for affected window. Good.

Jake Morales: Taking over on-call at 13:00 UTC. Handoff notes: monitor recon job, validate top-accounts diff, coordinate credits. My status: oncall-night.

Marco Diaz: Handoff checklist to Jake:
- Recon console: https://ci.redwood/jobs/recon-1900223344
- S3 results: s3://recon-results/recon-1900223344/
- Credit script: `tools/credits/apply_credits.py --input accounts_to_credit.csv`
- Reconciler writes a manifest to avoid double-applying credits

Jake Morales: Acknowledged. I'll validate diffs; if discrepancy > 2% for any top-10 account, I'll open priority support tickets and execute credits.

BillingOps: Preparing customer message draft; will not send until numbers validated.

Marco Diaz: Cleanup plan post-recon:
- Review `reconcile_manifest.json`
- Spot-check sample accounts
- If reconciled, scale `billing-forwarder` back to 1 and unmute alerts
- Run `apply_credits.py` for accounts flagged by BillingOps

Alice Nguyen: Created follow-up MR to add idempotency integration tests and lock down kafka-client version. MR: https://repo.redwood/infer/merge_requests/462

Priya Sharma: Incident declared mitigated at 13:20 UTC (immediate impact removed). Root cause: commit timing/regression in kafka client + insufficient idempotency handling caused duplicate batch processing. Follow-ups assigned: Marco (reconciler validation), Alice (bugfix + tests), BillingOps (credits & customer comms), Jake (overnight monitoring).

incident-bot: Incident record created: https://intranet.redwood/incidents/1900223344. Severity lowered to MONITORING.

Jake Morales: I'll draft a short postmortem in #postmortems by EOD tomorrow with timeline, scope, and action items. Thanks team.
